title: Hello!
text:
thanks for visiting my website! my name is kai. this is a place for my projects & digital artifacts, large and small. some serious projects, some experiments, and occasionally sharing whatever i’m working on.



fun fact: my github username started as a pytorch concatenate joke. i’ve forgotten the joke, but kept the cat 😸


i like making things, especially

title: About
text: i am currently studying computational linguistics, building on my personal learning in data science, software development, and machine learning. before this, i studied economics, and worked as a data analyst. —-fix below later i like making things somewhere between language, statistics, perception, and interactive systems. this is a place for those projects and smaller digital artifacts: experiments, useful tools, things that work, and things i’m still figuring out. i’ll link projects here and write about what i’m working on as it happens.
